title: CactusTiersTagger
description: View player's tiers from CactusTiers in-game.
body:
# CactusTiersTagger

**NOTE:** This mod depends on [ukulib](https://modrinth.com/mod/ukulib)

CactusTierTagger is a mod that displays a player's tiers in their nametag. View the online tierlist at [CactusTiers](https://tiers.cactusmc.xyz/) 

![tier on nametag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a642d19a1fb093ff6847d1df05bda69e14194f56.png)
